name: Safety: Unsafe Tool Use
description: LLM-judge evaluator (v1) that flags agent tool calls violating safety boundaries (filesystem writes outside sandboxes, untrusted code execution, dangerous shell invocations, etc.). v2 will add deterministic policy lookup; v1 reasons over query, response, and the tool-call sequence with an LLM judge.

expectedInputs.description: The user prompt that triggered the tool calls — context for the safety judgement.
Agent response — judged for whether the tool calls and their framing were appropriate.
Tool calls — the primary surface judged against the safety boundary.
